**Original Novel:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/47032064), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=3870387), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/565002004) (eBook)

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/56441323), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4132000433?), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6195962), [Comico](https://www.comico.kr/comic/3648)  
“A heart that can’t be compared to anything else…  …  I'm saying I love you, now."  Jenny Yoon is a Korean woman with American citizenship.  In Korea, where she stays for work, she meets three attractive men, Yeo Min-jun, Ji Seung-yoon, and Do Jae-hee.  If you take the first three names, it's female.  ji.  do.  Her heart melts at her innocent smile, and her heart starts beating relentlessly at her eccentric liveliness.  Her outspoken expression and free spirit are new.  Unpredictable, she rocks us now!  And who is the man Jenny chose?  Coming to Korea and meeting him again was the greatest fortune of her life, and choosing him must have been one of the best things she did in her life.  So they met and fell in love.  got married and lived together.  And I dreamed of the same future.  All of this started from the day the sun came down dazzlingly.
